(() => {
  const NativePromise = Promise;
  const nativeThen = NativePromise.prototype.then;
  class PagePromise {
    constructor(executor) { this.native = new NativePromise(executor); }
    then(fulfilled, rejected) {
      return new PagePromise((resolve, reject) => {
        const next = nativeThen.call(this.native, fulfilled, rejected);
        nativeThen.call(next, resolve, reject);
      });
    }
    catch(rejected) { return this.then(undefined, rejected); }
    static resolve(value) { return new PagePromise(resolve => resolve(value)); }
    static reject(reason) { return new PagePromise((resolve, reject) => reject(reason)); }
  }
  if (globalThis.promisePatchMode === "global") globalThis.Promise = PagePromise;
  else NativePromise.prototype.then = function(fulfilled, rejected) {
    return new PagePromise((resolve, reject) => {
      const next = nativeThen.call(this, fulfilled, rejected);
      nativeThen.call(next, resolve, reject);
    });
  };
  globalThis.comparison = (async () => {
    const result = await Promise.resolve(21).then(value => value * 2);
    const recovered = await Promise.reject(new Error("synthetic-rejection")).catch(error => error.message);
    const thenable = await { then(resolve) { resolve(7); } };
    const nested = await { then(resolve) { resolve(Promise.resolve(9)); } };
    const native = await (async () => 11)();
    const chained = await Promise.resolve(1).then(() => { throw new Error("synthetic-chain"); }).catch(error => error.message);
    document.body.dataset.result = String(result);
    return {
      patched: globalThis.promisePatchMode === "global" ? Promise === PagePromise : NativePromise.prototype.then !== nativeThen,
      fulfilled: result === 42,
      recovered: recovered === "synthetic-rejection",
      thenable: thenable === 7,
      nested: nested === 9,
      native: native === 11,
      chained: chained === "synthetic-chain",
      rendered: document.body.dataset.result === "42"
    };
  })();
})()
